W.note: The violet button drifts to a rose-tinted glow with a sheen sweep and a slow 500 ms return, which reads as airy and dreamlike, though three glass Save/Reserve buttons add backdrop-filter cost.

X.note: The hover glow is faint on the dark stage, the primary focus ring (#3b2bb8) nearly disappears against that stage, and the tuning lab panel clutters what should be a workshop page.

Y.note: A soft glow and halo ring ease in and out over 220 to 600 ms on the dark stage, with a focus ring that adapts to the backdrop, contrast checks, a disabled state and transform/opacity-only animation, though the default settle has no overshoot and the lab panel is dense.

Z.note: A hard white sheen band sweeping across the dark Send button and an infinite aura drift on hover read more as gloss than dream, though the swatch moodboard layout is tidy and holds at phone width.
